svg.text: Aster MCA Nano CH32 v0.3 / Soldering position guide - TOP VIEW
32 x 18 mm PCB | 33 fitted parts, HAND SOLDER | Blue 0603 LEDs + 1k resistors | C4 = 33 nF C0G
Red circles: pin 1. LED1 / LED2: cathode K (pad 1) toward USB, left in this TOP view. Check stock LED polarity.
USB shell: 2 plated slots, overall 2.50 x 0.90 mm. Locating pegs: 2 NPTH, diameter 1.10 mm.
Current build: 1.6 mm PCB. External SMA: center contact to J2 middle pad; shell to J2 upper/lower GND pads.
USB is LEFT, SMA is RIGHT. All 33 listed parts are fitted, including R9. RUN needs firmware; low level = ON.
